headline: Applied Digital has secured access to up to 1 gigawatt of potential power in Finland for its first data center project outside the United States.
score_reason: Pool 7 lowered by 1: the headline says it will develop a 1 GW campus, but the facts show only access to potential power, no named customer and conditional spending.
importance_line: It shows US AI builders looking to the Nordics for power, which matters to investors and Finnish communities, but the site, first-stage power and customers are all undisclosed and spending depends on approvals and customer demand.
source: W.Media, citing an Applied Digital press release
summary: W.Media reports, citing a press release, that Applied Digital, a US builder of AI data centers, has an agreement for access to up to 1 gigawatt of potential power capacity in Finland, its first development outside the United States, with initial power expected from 2028. The company is already talking to large cloud customers but has not named one, nor said where the site is, and further investment depends on customer demand and approvals.
